items.markdown:
A **salmon sperm facial** (also known as a **Salmon DNA Facial** or **PDRN therapy** ) is `a cosmetic treatment that uses purified DNA fragments extracted from salmon or trout sperm to repair and rejuvenate the skin`.[[1]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)[[3]](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/salmon-sperm-facial)

### How It Works

- **Purified Material:** The treatment does not use raw sperm; instead, it uses **polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN)** or polynucleotides—highly purified DNA fragments stripped of proteins and hormones in a lab.[[1]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)[[2]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)
- **Delivery Method:** The DNA fragments are delivered into the skin either topically (often combined with microneedling using devices like the SkinPen ) or via micro-injections.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)
- **Cellular Action:** The nucleotides act as building blocks that stimulate fibroblast cells to boost collagen, elastin production, and skin hydration.[[1]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[2]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)

### Benefits & Uses

- **Anti-Aging:** Reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and under-eye hollowness.
- **Skin Quality:** Improves overall texture, elasticity, and tone without adding artificial volume like traditional fillers.
- **Healing:** Offers anti-inflammatory properties that help soothe irritated skin and assist post-procedure recovery.[[1]](https://www.hazanyderm.com/blog/salmon-sperm-the-new-trend-in-skincare)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DUjnZNzkv4U/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)[[4]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)

### Safety & Regulation

- **FDA Status:** Injectable PDRN treatments are **not** currently approved by the U.S. FDA, though they are widely popular and legally available in countries like South Korea and parts of Europe.
- **Risks:** Side effects can include temporary redness, swelling, bruising, or potential allergic reactions for individuals with severe fish allergies.
- **Context in Skincare:** It sits alongside other unconventional natural trends explored in [BBC Future's breakdown of bizarre skincare rituals](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260327-the-bizarre-skincare-rituals-that-might-actually-work).[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rSPQS2CCuto)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[4]](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260327-the-bizarre-skincare-rituals-that-might-actually-work)
